backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles with access control plus a public lead capture system supporting CRUD operations for admins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping theme color updates and hardcoded color replacements to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing purposes of various frontend files including styles, config, components, data, and sections.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind layer defining light and dark OKLCH color tokens and global background/foreground styles.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML bootstrap file mounting the React app via root div and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React layout composing all major site sections with dark theme provider and scroll-to-section behavior.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Floating WhatsApp action button that opens a generated chat link in a new tab.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Footer displaying brand info, service areas, property types, contact details, and attribution using theme colors.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Sticky header with brand logo and consultation CTA using theme-based background and border styling.
frontend/src/components/properties/Prope: Renders a property card with key details, ROI badge, and a WhatsApp CTA link. Uses property data and COPY content for labels.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Displays an about section with highlight cards describing service features. Uses COPY content for heading and text.
frontend/src/components/sections/Feature: Provides a filterable list of properties with location, budget, and type filters. Renders matching PropertyCard components based on selected criteria.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Shows a hero banner with headline, subheadline, and two CTA buttons. Invokes callbacks for viewing investments and requesting consultation.
frontend/src/components/sections/Investo: Implements an investment calculator computing ROI from price and rent inputs. Displays calculated annual ROI with interactive form fields.
frontend/src/components/sections/LeadCap: Renders a lead capture form with validation and API submission, showing a success message upon completion. Uses COPY text and backend enums for form fields.
frontend/src/components/sections/Testimo: Displays testimonial cards with ratings, quotes, and author details. Pulls data from the testimonials dataset and COPY content for section text.
frontend/src/components/sections/WhyInve: Renders a section listing reasons to invest in Pune using icons and COPY content values.
frontend/src/config/whatsapp.ts: Defines WhatsApp configuration and helper functions to generate message links for general and property-specific inquiries.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Hosts all static UI copy strings for sections like hero, properties, forms, and footer.
frontend/src/data/properties.ts: Defines property types and a list of commercial property objects with details like area, price, rent, and ROI.
frontend/src/data/testimonials.ts: Exports the testimonial interface and sample investor testimonials with names, roles, and ratings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook for authentication, identity loading, login, and logout handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides a mutation hook for submitting lead forms through the backend actor and refreshing related queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles, CSS variables, dark mode values, and typography settings.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, wrapping it in query and identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash-based), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from session state or the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom colors, typography, animations, and plugins for container queries and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, including goals, design requirements, features, and architectural notes for the PKC Urban Capital website.
